title: Dental PPO Plans Patient Share on Prior-Level Corrections for Pediatric Members and Members with Other Coverage
content:
**Rule.** The patient share on a Dental PPO Plans line reprocessed after it was paid at the coinsurance of the plan held before an upgrade (a reprocessed prior-level line) follows the person and the other coverage:
- **Pediatric, in network.** For a person receiving the pediatric essential-health-benefit treatment on a line from an in-network practice, the patient share is first limited to the pediatric out-of-pocket room and then reduced by any primary payment recorded on the line. The room is the pediatric out-of-pocket maximum for one child less the person's pediatric out-of-pocket postings net of reversals for the line's benefit year, after any pediatric out-of-pocket posting the replaced decision made to that benefit year is backed out. The plan payment on such a line is the allowance less that limited share, so the line that crosses the pediatric out-of-pocket maximum pays the allowance minus the cost sharing still remaining, and a later line pays the full allowance.
- **Other lines with a primary payment.** For any other line on which a primary payment above 0.00 is recorded, the patient share is reduced by that primary payment.
- **Otherwise** the patient share is not adjusted.

The patient share is never below zero.

**Figures and terms.** The pediatric treatment applies on an individual exchange enrollment to a date of service before the person's 19th birthday (19 on every Dental PPO plan). An in-network practice is a PPO or Premier in-network practice. The one-child pediatric out-of-pocket maximum is 425.00 on Value 1000 and Plus 1500, and 0.00 on the other four plans.

### Worked case (hypothetical)
Value 1000, a 15-year-old, in-network line; the person's pediatric out-of-pocket postings for the year are 405.30 net, of which 61.20 was posted by the replaced decision; no primary payment; share before this rule 77.90.
- Postings after backing out the replaced decision's posting: 405.30 less 61.20, which is 344.10.
- Room: 425.00 less 344.10, which is 80.90.
- The share of 77.90 is within the room and stays 77.90.
